title: redact keeps the tail of a cut-off escaped-quote secret value after a nested escaped quote
goal: redact.redact replaces the whole of an escaped-quote secret value that holds a nested escaped quote and has no closing quote (a JSON string cut off mid-value), at escape levels 1 and 2, so no part of the value after the nested quote is left and a second pass changes nothing

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import redact as R
b=chr(92);q=chr(34);v='hunter'+'Fake123'
t1=b+q+'password'+b+q+': '+b+q+'a'+b*3+q+v
t2=b*3+q+'password'+b*3+q+': '+b*3+q+'a'+b*7+q+v
o=[R.redact(t) for t in (t1,t2)];print(o);sys.exit(1 if any(v in x for x in o) or [R.redact(x) for x in o] != o else 0)

notes: Found by the SP-5xnbspyp review (S3, BG-saeietup "redact keeps the tail of an escaped-JSON secret value after a nested escaped quote"): an unterminated value falls through to the bare-value alternative, which stops at the nested quote. Planner 2026-10-24: provenance moved out of the goal so it is one clause; the repro also asserts the second pass changes nothing.
